premises.text: 40% of food is wasted before it reaches consumers, creating a massive problem for food supply.
Converting pre-consumer food waste into protein offers a sustainable solution.
premises.evidence_span: if somehow we can convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems.

premises.text: Natransa produces protein from edible insects by converting food waste into fertilizer.
premises.evidence_span: Natransa produces the next generation protein from a specific edible insect by converting food waste into fertilizer.

premises.text: The production system is more efficient than traditional protein sources, needing minimal resources.
premises.evidence_span: Our production system is exponentially more efficient than any protein sources. It needs minimal water and land, requires zero grain, and almost produces zero carbon emission.

premises.text: The insect-based protein has higher nutritional value than regular meat.
premises.evidence_span: Our product has two times more protein, 100 times more calcium, and four times more phosphorus than regular meat.

premises.text: The market for alternative protein sources is large and accessible due to low regulations.
premises.evidence_span: it's a $70 billion worth market, and easy to access due to low regulations.

premises.text: There is a growing demand for alternative protein sources among various consumer segments.
premises.evidence_span: we first target three initial customer segments. One is athletes who already use whey protein additional to their diet.

premises.text: Natransa has a team of scientists and engineers with a shared vision for alternative protein.
premises.evidence_span: Our team consists of scientists and engineers from different fields, but with the same vision of making Natransa the leader of alternative protein food market.

value.text: Natransa provides a sustainable and nutritious alternative protein source.
value.evidence_span: join the international movement to sustain the growing world population.

notes: Traction metrics and personal credentials excluded as they do not support premises.
